premise.claim: With rbg.workloads.x-k8s.io/group-exclusive-topology on a v1alpha2 RoleBasedGroup, the group's first Pod never schedules: the injected required podAffinity selects rbg.workloads.x-k8s.io/group-unique-hash, a label no Pod carries (Pods carry the same hash under group-uid).
premise.evidence: On base 1fc69f70 the rendered pod template's required affinity selects group-unique-hash while its labels carry only group-uid with the same value (selector mismatch -> self-match fails -> first Pod unschedulable). Bug introduced by the v1alpha2-storage migration 415f5869 (#188); the original v1alpha1 implementation 26df2e70 (#32) selected the label its Pods actually carried. See results/unit-base.txt and results/envtest-base.txt.

match: renders a self-matching group-uid affinity on the RoleInstanceSet template
